import pytest
from datetime import date
from calc import LateFeeCalculator  # adjust import

def mk(today):
    return LateFeeCalculator(today=today)

def test_balance_zero_or_negative():
    c = mk(date(2024,1,1))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(0, date(2023,1,1)) == 0
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(-100, date(2023,1,1)) == 0

def test_end_before_start_no_days():
    c = mk(date(2024,1,1))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,6,1)) == 0

def test_within_grace_no_fee():
    # due Mon Jan1 2024, today Jan12 2024 (weekdays < grace)
    c = mk(date(2024,1,12))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,1)) == 0

def test_past_grace_min_fee():
    # small balance, short billable days -> min fee applies
    c = mk(date(2024,1,17))  # due Jan1, few billable weekdays past grace
    fee = c.compute_fee_cents(1000, date(2024,1,1))
    assert fee == 500

def test_normal_fee_calc():
    c = mk(date(2024,3,1))
    fee = c.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024,1,1))
    assert 500 < fee < 25000

def test_max_fee_cap():
    c = mk(date(2025,1,1))
    fee = c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2020,1,1))
    assert fee == 2500

def test_weekend_excluded():
    c = mk(date(2024,1,8))  # Mon, due Fri Jan5 -> only 1 weekday
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,5)) == 0
